top_story: After five months of war with Iran, Washington has sharply raised coercive pressure on Tehran, with Trump coupling talk of imminent negotiations on 3 August to explicit threats of “decapitation” if no deal emerges. The regional picture is one of mounting military exhaustion alongside expanding social ruin, leaving any diplomatic opening burdened by weakened state capacity and severe long-term human damage.
